phases.title: Environment Setup and Project Scaffold
phases.deliverable: `python -c 'import google.adk; import ollama; print("ok")'` prints `ok` from inside the project virtualenv
tasks: Create project structure with directories: agents/, tools/, tests/fixtures/, docs/, scripts/
Install Python 3.11 virtualenv and add google-adk, ollama, python-dotenv, pytest, pytest-mock to requirements.txt
Pull Gemma 3 model locally via `ollama pull gemma3` and verify `ollama list` shows gemma3
Create config.py that loads REPOS_PATH, DIGEST_PATH, GEMINI_API_KEY, OLLAMA_BASE_URL, OLLAMA_MODEL, DIGEST_LOOKBACK_DAYS from .env using python-dotenv
Create .env.example listing all six required environment variables with placeholder values
Add .env and __pycache__ entries to .gitignore
phases.commit_condition: Run `python -c 'import google.adk; import ollama; print("ok")'` inside the virtualenv — prints `ok` with no ImportError
phases.example_input: Empty ADK-Agent/ directory with only .git and .claude/
phases.example_output: Run `python -c 'import google.adk; import ollama; print("ok")'` — terminal prints `ok`; `ollama list` shows gemma3; project tree shows agents/, tools/, tests/fixtures/, config.py, .env.example

phases.title: Repo Analysis Tools
phases.deliverable: `pytest tests/test_repo_tools.py -v` reports all tests passing against fixture repos in tests/fixtures/
tasks: Create tests/fixtures/fake_repo/ containing a package.json with 3 dependencies, a pyproject.toml, and a stub git log text file with 5 fake commit entries
Implement list_repos(repos_path: str) -> list[str] in tools/repo_tools.py returning subdirectory names under repos_path
Implement read_git_log(repo_path: str) -> dict in tools/repo_tools.py parsing last commit date and 10 most recent commit messages via `git log`

Implement read_dependencies(repo_path: str) -> list[str] in tools/repo_tools.py reading package.json, pyproject.toml, requirements.txt, or go.mod; falling back to file-extension inference from git log output if no dependency file exists
Write tests/test_repo_tools.py with unit tests for list_repos, read_git_log, read_dependencies, and the extension-inference fallback path against tests/fixtures/fake_repo/
phases.commit_condition: Run `pytest tests/test_repo_tools.py -v` — all tests pass with 0 failures, minimum 6 test cases covering list_repos, read_git_log, read_dependencies, and the extension-inference fallback

phases.title: Digest Reader Tools
phases.deliverable: `pytest tests/test_digest_tools.py -v` reports all tests passing against fixture digest files in tests/fixtures/fake_digests/
tasks: Create tests/fixtures/fake_digests/ containing 3 fake .txt digest files with ISO dates in filenames and tech topic paragraphs (FastAPI, Rust, OpenTofu) in body text
Implement list_digest_files(digest_path: str) -> list[str] in tools/digest_tools.py returning .txt file paths sorted by filename date descending
Implement read_digest(file_path: str) -> str in tools/digest_tools.py returning raw text content of a single digest file
Write tests/test_digest_tools.py with unit tests covering list ordering, file reading, and empty-directory handling
phases.commit_condition: Run `pytest tests/test_digest_tools.py -v` — all tests pass with 0 failures; verify list_digest_files returns files in descending date order
phases.example_input: tests/fixtures/fake_digests/ contains 2026-05-01.txt, 2026-05-06.txt, 2026-05-08.txt each with paragraph text mentioning tech topics

phases.title: Parsing Agents on Gemma via Ollama
tasks: Implement RepoAnalysisAgent in agents/repo_analysis.py as an ADK LlmAgent using OLLAMA_MODEL, with tools list_repos, read_git_log, and read_dependencies attached, and a system prompt instructing it to return structured JSON: [{repo, technologies[], last_used}]

Implement DigestReaderAgent in agents/digest_reader.py as an ADK LlmAgent using OLLAMA_MODEL, with tools list_digest_files and read_digest attached, and a system prompt instructing it to return structured JSON: [{topic, mentions, date}]
Write integration tests for RepoAnalysisAgent and DigestReaderAgent in tests/test_agents.py using pytest-mock to patch Ollama LLM responses, asserting output schema matches expected structure
phases.commit_condition: Run `pytest tests/test_agents.py::test_repo_analysis_agent tests/test_agents.py::test_digest_reader_agent -v` — both tests pass; no real Ollama calls made during the test run
phases.example_input: Mocked Ollama response for RepoAnalysisAgent set to return `[{"repo": "BloodReview", "technologies": ["express", "mysql2"], "last_used": "2025-10-01"}]`

phases.title: Suggestion and Coordinator Agents on Gemini
phases.deliverable: `pytest tests/test_agents.py -v` passes all 4 agent tests with mocked Gemini and Ollama responses
tasks: Implement SuggestionAgent in agents/suggestion.py as an ADK LlmAgent using Gemini 2.0 Flash, accepting repo analysis output and digest reader output in context, with a system prompt instructing it to stream 3–5 concrete project suggestions linking underused tech to digest trends
Implement CoordinatorAgent in agents/coordinator.py as an ADK LlmAgent using Gemini 2.0 Flash, owning the top-level user query and delegating to the pipeline defined in pipeline.py
Add integration tests for SuggestionAgent and CoordinatorAgent to tests/test_agents.py using pytest-mock to patch Gemini API responses
phases.commit_condition: Run `pytest tests/test_agents.py -v` — all 4 agent tests pass with 0 failures; no real API calls to Gemini or Ollama made
phases.example_input: Mocked SuggestionAgent context includes repo data showing mysql2 unused for 7 months and digest data mentioning CDC twice in the last week
phases.example_output: SuggestionAgent.run() streams text beginning with `→ You haven't used mysql2 in 7 months.` followed by a CDC-related project suggestion

phases.title: Pipeline Assembly and Streaming CLI
phases.deliverable: `python main.py 'what should I build this week?'` streams 3–5 project suggestions to the terminal using live Gemini and Ollama calls
tasks: Implement pipeline.py wiring ParallelAgent([repo_analysis_agent, digest_reader_agent]) as phase 1 and SuggestionAgent as phase 2 inside a SequentialAgent, owned by CoordinatorAgent
Implement main.py CLI entry point accepting an optional query string argument, instantiating the CoordinatorAgent, and running it via ADK's streaming runner with live token output to stdout
Write tests/test_pipeline.py smoke test running the full pipeline against tests/fixtures/ with mocked agent responses, asserting suggestions stream without errors
Add error handling in main.py for Ollama-not-reachable (check OLLAMA_BASE_URL on startup, exit with clear message), missing .env keys, and Gemini API failure
phases.commit_condition: Run `python main.py 'what should I build this week?'` with real .env configured — terminal streams at least 3 suggestions each starting with `→`; run `pytest tests/test_pipeline.py -v` — smoke test passes
phases.example_input: Run `python main.py 'what should I build this week?'` with REPOS_PATH pointing to a directory with 3 repos and DIGEST_PATH pointing to 5 digest .txt files
phases.example_output:
Terminal streams:
`→ You haven't used mysql2 in 7 months.
  Your digest mentioned CDC twice this week.
  Idea: build a lightweight CDC listener using MySQL binlog + Python.

→ You haven't touched Terraform in 4 months.
  Digest flagged OpenTofu 1.9 last Tuesday.
  Idea: migrate your AWS infra to OpenTofu.`

phases.title: Documentation, Test Finalisation, and GitHub Export
phases.deliverable: `pytest tests/ -v` reports all tests passing; README.md renders project overview and setup steps; GitHub Actions workflow at .github/workflows/phasecompiler-import.yml creates milestones and issues from plan.json on push to main
tasks: Write README.md documenting project purpose, prerequisites (Python 3.11, Ollama, Gemma 3, Gemini API key), setup steps referencing .env.example, and an example terminal output block
Finalise tests/ to cover all tools, all four agents, and the pipeline smoke test — ensure no test makes real API calls to Gemini or Ollama
Create .github/workflows/phasecompiler-import.yml triggering on push to main for plan.json changes and on workflow_dispatch, using GITHUB_TOKEN to create milestones and issues
Create scripts/phasecompiler_import.py reading plan.json and creating GitHub milestones and issues idempotently via the GitHub REST API using hidden HTML comment markers
phases.commit_condition: Run `pytest tests/ -v` — all tests pass with 0 failures; push to main — GitHub Actions workflow triggers and creates 7 milestones and all task issues; trigger workflow a second time — no duplicate milestones or issues created
phases.example_input: All source files written; plan.json at project root with 7 phases; .env.example committed; .env gitignored
phases.example_output: GitHub repository shows 7 milestones (Phase 1: Environment Setup … Phase 7: Documentation), each with task issues assigned; `pytest tests/ -v` prints all tests passed; README.md renders with setup steps and example output block
